values.meaning: Victory Zone heal per second (per ally within the zone)

values.quote: challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds

values.binNote: No bin data value carries the 0.25s tick interval; it only appears as a tooltip {{fd|0.25}} literal in the wiki description, with HealPerSecondCalc being the underlying per-second rate the bin actually tracks.

mechanics.claim: Highlights all four Vitals on the target after a 0.5-second delay.
mechanics.quote: highlighting all four of their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay

mechanics.claim: The damage of this ability (via triggered Vitals) scales with Duelist's Dance.
mechanics.quote: The damage of this ability scales with {{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, not on effect end.
If Fiora triggers at least one Vital before the target dies, or all four otherwise, a Victory Zone is created that heals Fiora and allies every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: a ''{{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}}'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The Victory Zone triggers even if Fiora herself dies, as long as she hit a Vital before the target's death.
mechanics.quote: Even if '''Fiora''' dies, the {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|''Victory Zone''}} will trigger so long as she hit at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} and they die before the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} wear off.

mechanics.claim: The Victory Zone does not heal untargetable units.
mechanics.quote: The {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}} will not heal {{tip|untargetable}} units.

mechanics.claim: Recasting on a target already affected by Grand Challenge incurs only a 1-second cooldown instead of casting.
mechanics.quote: Attempting to cast ''Grand Challenge'' on a target already affected by it will incur a 1-second cooldown and a text saying that the ability cannot be stacked will pop out of the target.
